One entry point (e.g. mix defk.verify [asan|ubsan|valgrind|fuzz|cbmc|leaks]) so each check runs as its own task, plus a release alias/step that runs the release set. Not added to mix ci. Mac: ASan via OTP's asan emulator or DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES with +Mea min (see research note §1); Linux: Valgrind container. Documents how to run each in docs/guides/testing.md.
title: mix task to run the verification checks on demand, and a release alias that runs them
